subject: Stripe Technical Interview Invitation — Round 2 (Systems Scaling)
body:
Hi Alex,

We were really impressed by your initial technical screening! We would love to invite you to Round 2 of our interview process with our Engineering Director and Principal Architect.

The discussion will focus on payment platform architecture, idempotency keys, and distributed system resilience.

Please pick a time on this link for a 45-minute Google Meet session: https://calendly.com/stripe-talent/alex-chen

Best regards,
Sarah Connor | Stripe Talent Acquisition

subject: CONGRATULATIONS: Selected as Cloud Specialist ($140k/yr)
body:
Dear Candidate,

You have been selected without technical interview due to urgent requirements on our client project. Your confirmed annual salary is $140,000.

Please note: candidates must deposit a mandatory refundable equipment & training fee of $150 (₹12,500) via Zelle or Crypto before our logistics team can courier the corporate Apple MacBook Pro M3.

Reply with payment slip immediately to claim your offer letter.

subject: Update regarding your Google Cloud application
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with our hiring team. After careful consideration, we have decided not to move forward with your candidacy for this particular role at this time.

Our team was genuinely impressed by your deep background in Kubernetes and distributed systems. We will keep your resume on file for upcoming senior openings.

We wish you the very best in your search.

subject: Urgent Document Verification for Background Screening (Mandatory)
body:
Greetings Applicant,

Your profile has been shortlisted from LinkedIn talent pool. Before scheduling an interview call with the Delivery Head, company compliance requires candidates to upload front and back scans of your Aadhaar card and PAN card, along with 6 months bank passbook copy for KYC background check.

Send color scans to this email within 24 hours or your profile will be blacklisted.

subject: Thank you for applying to Datadog!
body:
Hello Alex,

We have received your application for the Frontend Engineer (Platform) position. Our recruiting team will review your profile against our open requisitions and reach out if there is a match.

You can check the status of your application anytime in our Greenhouse candidate portal.

Best regards,
Datadog Talent Team

subject: Invitation: Portfolio & Code Architecture Walkthrough at Figma
body:
Hey Alex!

Loved your open-source projects and component library on GitHub. Let's schedule a 60-minute session next Tuesday to walk through one of your system architectures and discuss our collaborative canvas engine.

Looking forward to speaking!

Dave | Figma Engineering Recruiting

subject: Official Offer Letter: Lead Product Specialist @ Notion Labs
body:
Dear Alex,

On behalf of the entire Notion team, we are ecstatic to extend an offer of employment for the role of Lead Product Specialist!

Compensation Summary:
- Base Salary: $210,000 USD
- Equity Grant: $180,000 RSU value (4-year vesting schedule)
- Signing Incentive: $25,000 upfront

Your official DocuSign agreement and benefits documentation are attached. Please review and sign by Friday.

Welcome to Notion!

subject: Application Status: Software Development Engineer II (Job ID: 29841)
body:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you for your interest in Amazon Web Services. We are currently reviewing your qualifications against the requirements for this position. We appreciate your patience while this process is underway.

Due to high volume, candidates will be notified once recruiter screening concludes.

subject: DIRECT SELECTION OFFER: Backend Engineer (Immediate Joining)
body:
Congratulations!

You are selected directly for the Backend Engineer position based on resume screening.

Package: 18 LPA CTC.

To process your formal appointment letter and schedule IT dispatch, candidate must deposit ₹4,999 towards training and anti-cheating assessment fees to GPay/PhonePe number 98765-XXXXX.

Offer valid for today only. Failure to pay will result in immediate disqualification.

subject: Airbnb Application: Update on your submission
body:
Hello Alex,

We received many exceptional applications for the Staff Infrastructure Engineer position, and unfortunately, we will not be moving forward with your candidacy at this time.

We appreciate the time you invested in exploring opportunities with Airbnb and wish you success in your next role.

Warm regards,
Airbnb Recruiting Team

subject: Next Steps: Conversation with Canva Hiring Manager
body:
Hi Alex,

We would like to schedule a 30-minute conversation with our Engineering Manager for the Design Platform team to discuss your background and technical architecture interests.

Please let us know your availability over the next few days.

Best,
Canva Talent Acquisition

subject: Thank you for applying to Microsoft (Req #189201)
body:
Thank you for applying to Microsoft. Your application for Senior Software Engineer (Azure Core) has been routed to our recruiting team. If your qualifications match our team needs, an engineering recruiter will reach out directly.

You can check your application status on Microsoft Action Center.

subject: Your application to Atlassian — SRE
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to Atlassian. While we were impressed by your background, we have decided to pursue candidates whose specific infrastructure experience more closely matches the immediate requirements of this team.

We appreciate your interest in Atlassian and wish you the best.

subject: PAN and Aadhaar submission required prior to interview call
body:
Dear Applicant,

To prevent candidate impersonation in AI screenings, our enterprise clients mandate that candidates submit their original Aadhaar Card scan, PAN card, and 3 months salary slips prior to scheduling any technical rounds.

Failing to submit these documents to this email within 12 hours will permanently cancel your profile.

subject: Application Received: Data Platform Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for submitting your application to Snowflake. Our engineering recruiters are actively reviewing candidates on a rolling basis. If your profile matches our criteria, we will reach out with scheduling details.

Best,
Snowflake Talent Team

subject: Shopify: Thank you for your interest
body:

Thank you again for your interest in Shopify.

subject: Application Acknowledgement: Systems Engineer
body:
